in_hebrew.name: Goldwin
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Friend of Gold

This name was given to a child born to a family who valued friendship, wealth, and protection. In Christian tradition, it is believed that the name Goldwin embodies the virtues of faith and generosity.
